nodes.question: What are the determinants of green packaging that influence buyers' willingness to pay a price premium according to Singh and Pander (2018)?
nodes.answer: Singh and Pander (2018) suggest that the determinants of green packaging that influence buyers' willingness to pay a price premium include factors such as environmental concern, perceived product quality, and social influence.
